title: Nearly a million open flow mappings and nothing else
notes: The input is 999,999 opening braces and is never closed, so it is an error: a syntax error at the end of the input, or a limit error if the reader refuses the nesting first. No result is allowed. A reader that keeps a full node for every open collection takes memory in proportion to the depth, so a reader with no depth limit goes over 64 MB just returning a million events before the error, and the memory bound separates a reader with a depth limit or a compact stack from one that builds the whole chain before it fails. The bounds are the robustness requirement of the kit, not a rule of the specification.

provenance.reference: A reader that allocated about 200 MB before failing on this input.
